title: Easy Going Japanese Chicken Drumsticks Dorayaki
description: A briny and gooey Japanese dish from the Tohoku region featuring chicken drumsticks and steamed ingredients, perfect as a hangover cure, and can be adapted to be vegetarian friendly by substituting the chicken with a vegetarian alternative, the dish is formed into a dorayaki shape
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together mirin, soy sauce, sake, brown sugar, and rice vinegar to make the marinade.
Add the chicken drumsticks to the marinade and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Preheat a steamer with water to 212 degrees Fahrenheit.
Steam the marinated chicken drumsticks for 10 minutes.
In a small bowl, whisk together water and red miso paste to make the glaze.
Brush the glaze over the steamed chicken drumsticks.
Form the chicken drumsticks into a dorayaki shape by placing two drumsticks together with a small amount of glaze in between.
Serve the Easy Going Japanese Chicken Drumsticks Dorayaki hot.
Garnish with sliced green onions and grated daikon radish if desired.
